Seit 2. August 2026 muss sichtbar sein,: Since 2 August 2026, what AI made has to be visible.
Wer als Unternehmen Bilder, Videos oder: A business that publishes images, videos or recordings that look real but were created or modified with AI has to label them – visibly, at the latest at first sight. The duty is yours as the site owner, not the AI tool maker's.
Deepfakes: Bilder, Videos, Audio mit KI,: Deepfakes: AI images, videos, audio that show real or plausible people, things, places or events and look real – also an invented but photorealistic person.
KI-Texte, die die \u00d6ffentlichkeit \u: AI texts that inform the public on matters of public interest – unless a person reviewed them and takes responsibility.
Whether you meant to deceive does not matter. What your audience believes counts.
Normale Bearbeitung: Ausschnitt, Licht,: Ordinary editing: crop, light, colour, noise, dust, upscaling – also with AI tools.
Offensichtlich k\u00fcnstliche Bilder (I: Obviously artificial images (illustration, comic, abstract): voluntary, but good for trust.
Inhalte, die vor dem 2. August 2026 erze: Content created before 2 August 2026 – nothing applies retroactively.
Kunst, Satire, Fiktion: ja, aber so, das: Art, satire, fiction: yes, but so that the work does not suffer (e.g. in the caption).
Auf oder direkt am Inhalt, ohne Klick er: On or right at the content, visible without a click – not only in the imprint.
Klare Worte: \u201eKI-generiert\u201c, \: Plain words: “AI-generated”, “Modified with AI”. For screen readers as the icon's name, never instead of the alt text.
Videos: die ganze Zeit in einer Ecke. Au: Videos: in a corner the whole time. Audio: at the player and in the artwork.
Wasserzeichen oder Metadaten des KI-Werk: The AI tool's watermark or metadata does not count for you.
Seit Juni 2026 von der Kommission, frei: From the Commission since June 2026, free to use, no attribution. Optional – an equivalent label is allowed too.
Ganz mit KI erzeugt, ohne menschlich gem: Fully created with AI, no human-made parts.
Echtes Foto, Video oder echte Aufnahme,: Real photo, video or recording, partly modified with AI.
Das Basis-Icon: mit eigenem Text, mit zw: The basic icon: with your own text, with a second layer or where space is short.
Viele KI-Werkzeuge schreiben in die Date: Many AI tools write into the file that it was made with AI: Content Credentials (C2PA) from ChatGPT, Gemini, Firefly or Photoshop, the IPTC value “trainedAlgorithmicMedia”, the generation data of Stable Diffusion and ComfyUI. The plugin reads them on upload and with every check – on your server, nothing leaves it.
Fehlt eine Spur, hei\u00dft das nichts:: A missing trace means nothing: screenshots, exports and image optimisers remove them. That is why “Used, not decided” shows everything visible on your site that has no decision yet. Only you know for sure how an image was made.
